newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end mixed, seen volatile.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end mixed, seen volatile.

text.p: Austrian bonds recovered early losses in quiet trade on Monday. Dealers said the market would be looking to Tuesday's U.S. employment cost index for clues.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 down 25 bps at 100.00 to yield 5.62 (5.59) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.03/11 to yield 5.62/61 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 steady at 99.60 to yield 4.72 (4.72) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.53/61 to yield 4.73/71 percent.
* Austrian bond future down four bps at 109.95 on turnover of 120 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany six bps, five-year spread 22 bps.
* Money market rates three-month VIBOR at 3.400 and overnight money at 3.12/3.37.
